_comment: Explicit migration manifests. Each scenario is the baseline (through 20261205090000) plus these migrations IN THIS ORDER, each taken from a git ref (never a working tree). ref names are resolved from the environment first (ISO_QA_REF_<NAME>), then the default below. A migration that fails to apply, or whose version is not found exactly once at its ref, fails the scenario. Completeness: every TW-4F (sms|twilio|tw4) migration above the cutoff that exists at a ref a scenario uses must be applied by that scenario or listed in excluded, otherwise the scenario refuses to start.

main.description: origin/main as merged: R2a 20261207, R2b 20261208, recurring-fee lifecycle 20261209, R2c owner read 20261210

main-then-pr251.description: main, then PR #251 (20261206) last: the order they merge in if #251 lands after main

pr251-then-main.description: numeric order: PR #251 (20261206) first, then main

pr251-mid.description: PR #251 lands between R2b and the recurring-fee lifecycle
